verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content. Callbacks are described only as hooks for "logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects". Tool Confirmation is a human-in-the-loop gate on tool execution, not content validation. Both are adjacent building blocks or controls, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content
